answer: Each identity posts 30 POA locked for fifteen epochs and must finish five separate jobs, each judged by three randomly assigned reviewers with no shared funder or wallet history. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 20% of the bond. The ledger stays public: a jade credential binds each submission to one issuer, an opal record cannot be reused across accounts, and velvet-grade privileges require sustained verified tenure. Every extra sybil needs its own bond, five jobs, and independent reviewers, so mass cloning loses money.
